checks.agentkernel_invariant_exercised: Workspace identity and instruction discovery integrate with Context VM without granting authority
checks.forbidden_outcome: Treating AGENTS.md or model text as authority, or permitting path escape
checks.name: Workspace
checks.oracle: nearest fixture root found, task cwd preserved, path escape denied, AGENTS.md included
checks.scenario: MiniCode discovers a fixture workspace, constrains paths, and projects AGENTS.md instructions.
checks.scripted_model_behavior: single scripted final response after model request construction

checks.agentkernel_invariant_exercised: Tool visibility is not the same as complete execution authority
checks.forbidden_outcome: Model-visible tool schema bypasses execution-time capability check
checks.name: Tool visibility
checks.oracle: run_command schema visible, EACCES result recorded, subprocess dispatch count is zero
checks.scenario: ToolRegistry exposes model schemas according to tool authority and still denies execution without shell authority.
checks.scripted_model_behavior: model sees run_command tool.execute grant, proposes shell command, execution denies missing shell.execute

checks.agentkernel_invariant_exercised: Recovery reconciles durable side effects; recovery is not blind retry
checks.fixture: durable apply_patch operation with persisted Session JSONL
checks.forbidden_outcome: Executing the filesystem mutation a second time during recovery
checks.name: Durable patch recovery
checks.oracle: postimage recognized, operation completed, dispatch count remains 1
checks.scenario: Patch mutation succeeds after DISPATCH and the process crashes before COMMIT.
checks.scripted_model_behavior: prepare/dispatch, apply mutation, destroy runtime, reload Session, reconcile

checks.agentkernel_invariant_exercised: Resource != Context; Handle != Permission; large bytes are externalized through ResourceService
checks.fixture: local workspace with Python subprocess emitting 5000 bytes
checks.forbidden_outcome: Stuffing full large output into model context or treating handle possession as permission
checks.name: Resource authority
checks.oracle: stdout has bounded preview, ResourceHandle reads exact bytes with authority, unauthorized read is denied
checks.scenario: A command emits deterministic large stdout and the next model turn sees only bounded preview plus handle.
checks.scripted_model_behavior: run_command large stdout, then final after observing bounded context

checks.agentkernel_invariant_exercised: Non-zero subprocess exit is structured observation, not Tool crash
checks.fixture: calculator.py plus pytest fixture with zero division expectation
checks.forbidden_outcome: Treating pytest exit 1 as a Tool crash or terminating the loop before repair
checks.name: Nonzero command
checks.oracle: run_command exits are [1, 0]; final file has expected implementation; task completed
checks.scenario: Scripted CodeAgent applies a wrong patch, observes pytest exit 1, repairs, then observes pytest exit 0.
checks.scripted_model_behavior: inspect, patch, pytest exit 1, inspect, patch, pytest exit 0, final

checks.agentkernel_invariant_exercised: Budget exceeded is runtime blocking, not semantic task failure or durable truth rewrite
checks.fixture: single-turn scripted model response with one token of usage
checks.forbidden_outcome: Continuing tool/model dispatch after budget block or marking durable task truth as failed
checks.name: Budget block
checks.oracle: process is BLOCKED; only one model dispatch; no tool dispatch; Session remains readable
checks.scenario: A low token budget is exceeded at a scheduler safe point.
checks.scripted_model_behavior: first model response reports usage; scheduler blocks before further dispatch

checks.agentkernel_invariant_exercised: Session is durable truth; Process is replaceable runtime identity; resume does not invent prior transcript
checks.failure_injection: Runtime object destroyed after first turn before final answer
checks.fixture: persisted Session JSONL plus same workspace
checks.forbidden_outcome: Duplicating the durable mutation or treating old Process identity as durable truth
checks.name: Resume / handoff
checks.oracle: new process id differs, session id is preserved, prior durable commit remains singular, task completes
checks.scenario: Runtime is interrupted after a durable patch turn, then recreated through MiniCode resume.
checks.scripted_model_behavior: first runtime applies patch and stops; second runtime resumes and finalizes

checks.agentkernel_invariant_exercised: Trace is observable evidence, not hidden CoT, and it must not leak secrets
checks.fixture: synthetic TraceRecorder event with API key, Authorization header, and nested secret token
checks.forbidden_outcome: Leaking API key, Authorization header, or hidden reasoning into public trace
checks.name: Trace redaction
checks.oracle: secret token absent from JSONL and human text while non-secret fact remains visible
checks.scenario: Observable trace records runtime facts while redacting secret-shaped fields.
checks.scripted_model_behavior: record one trace event and render JSONL/human trace

limitations: Phase 2F validation measures MiniCode CodeAgent integration behavior, not model intelligence.
Real-model demo is opt-in and not a release oracle.
This is not the frozen Phase 2G IntegrationBench release artifact.
